hypothesis: New default builds preserve scoped service performance; bounded optional writer tracing stays within declared latency/memory overhead limits, with independently calibrated controls.
order: Twelve rounds; each six-round half independently balances all six pair orders and positions per family/profile. Both A/A labels use the same executable path.
metrics: Overall/query/append p50/p95/p99/max, scheduled-arrival service time, rate, all losses, native peak working set/commit and charged native CPU.
cpu: Native GetProcessTimes delta before arrivals through completed/drained load, sampled before trace getter. Diagnostic only; no exclusive component or CPU-overhead certification. 100ns units do not imply timing resolution.
memory: Native GetProcessMemoryInfo PeakWorkingSetSize through post-load sample, before any trace getter; includes seeding/startup and workload, excludes later snapshot serialization/reopen. Not isolated tracer allocation or whole-process-lifetime peak after getter.
trace: Only after timers; whole idle snapshot required, zero dropped events, exact attempt/generation/first-key/row correlation with every attempted/ACKed append. Epoch process-local; no parse/dispatch clock or exclusive p99 cause.
diagnostic_followups: Individual stage/queue/maintenance events are observational unless both required compatibility/overhead full-and-block gates pass. Even calibrated observational association is not proof of physical cause.
both_stages_run: Run all predeclared families even if one fails numerical gates. Stop on hard runtime/correctness/setup failure, retain all partial and unstarted status; no selective rerun.
host_telemetry: Existing identical 1Hz whole-host sampler, charged in all variants; no heavy independent work.
smokes: All six exact binaries, 1000 starting rows, four clients, one second/100 offered write ops, excluded from every gate.
limits: Read/write-heavy eight-second profiles only; no minute/overload/scan/native-query/competitor refresh.
Fixed tolerance checks from twelve pairs/six-pair balanced halves are not statistical confidence intervals.
Original vs rebuilt comparisons include build/compiler/layout/version effects; no unique engine-change causality.
Scoped overhead pass is not a release, universal speed win, physical power-loss or complete tracing qualification.
Historical061/068/087 qualification reused exactly, not newly rerun in088. Every rejected trial stays preserved.
